_readme: Copy to config.json (setup.bat does this) and fill in keys. config.json is gitignored.
_trainer: Used in the boot speech: "...programmed by Professor Oak for Pokemon trainer <trainer_name> of the town of <hometown>..."
_tts_engine: auto = ElevenLabs when key+voice are set, else Windows SAPI. Or force: elevenlabs | sapi
_elevenlabs_voice_id: Create the Dexter voice in the ElevenLabs dashboard (Voice Design or Voice Lab) and paste its ID here.
_stt_model: faster-whisper model: tiny.en (fastest) | base.en | small.en (most accurate)
